description_short: A 2D Persona fighting game by Arc System Works that includes the Ultimax content package and the original Persona 4 Arena story.
description_ar: ادخل بطولة P-1 CLIMAX مع شخصيات من Persona 3 وPersona 4 في لعبة قتال ثنائية الأبعاد من Arc System Works. تستخدم الضربات الخاصة واستدعاءات الـPersona وأنظمة قتال متقدمة، مع تضمين قصة Persona 4 Arena الأصلية ومحتوى Ultimax.
nintendoNotes:
Nintendo lists Persona 4 Arena Ultimax as supported on Nintendo Switch 2 with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch. The Switch release supports TV/Tabletop/Handheld modes, 1–2 local players and online play for multiple players.

The modern Ultimax release includes previously released P4AU content and the original Persona 4 Arena story.

Supplier selection supplied by user: Simplified Chinese. Western Nintendo listings do not list Chinese, so this is preserved as supplier regional/SKU information. Regular / 普通版 ¥6.8 (pre-discount ¥10); Standard / 标准版 ¥55.8 (pre-discount ¥60). Converted costs: Regular 1,250 IQD; Standard 12,250 IQD. Supplier Standard is marked 即将售罄 / near sold out, so type.2 stock is overridden to low_supplier_stock below.

Only two supplier variants exist; no separate supplier DLC types are created.

gameplayPillars.title: Arc System Works Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Use Arc System Works-style normals, special moves, supers, bursts and Persona-assisted attacks in fast one-on-one fights.

gameplayPillars.title: Persona-Powered Roster
gameplayPillars.description: Choose from Persona 4 and Persona 3 fighters, including Shadow variants with distinct mechanics and play styles.

gameplayPillars.title: Story and Competitive Modes
gameplayPillars.description: Follow cinematic story routes that connect the original Persona 4 Arena narrative with Ultimax’s continuation.

gameplayPillars.title: Train and Compete
gameplayPillars.description: Use training and local/online versus modes to practice character-specific combos, Persona pressure and defensive systems.

worldSummary: The story returns to Inaba and the Midnight Channel setting, escalating into the P-1 CLIMAX where familiar Persona users are forced into a new fighting tournament tied to a larger supernatural incident.

storyChapters.title: Return of the P-1 Tournament
storyChapters.body: After the earlier P-1 Grand Prix, a new tournament appears with higher stakes and familiar fighters drawn back into the Midnight Channel conflict.

storyChapters.title: Persona 3 and Persona 4 Collide
storyChapters.body: Persona 3 and Persona 4 characters investigate the source of the P-1 CLIMAX while facing opponents and Shadow versions across multiple perspectives.

storyChapters.title: The Ultimax Confrontation
storyChapters.body: The combined story content incorporates the original Persona 4 Arena events and Ultimax’s continuation toward the confrontation behind the tournament.

storyChapters.title: After the P-1 CLIMAX
storyChapters.body: The conclusion resolves the immediate tournament conflict while reconnecting characters and threads from the broader Persona 3 and Persona 4 stories.

faq.q: Does Persona 4 Arena Ultimax support Simplified Chinese?
faq.a: The supplier listing says Simplified Chinese, but western Nintendo pages do not list Chinese. It is therefore stored as regional/SKU-specific supplier language rather than universal language support.

faq.q: Does Persona 4 Arena Ultimax work on Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo explicitly lists Nintendo Switch 2 compatibility as supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.

faq.q: Does Persona 4 Arena Ultimax have multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. It supports local competitive play and online multiplayer. Nintendo Switch Online is required for online matches.

faq.q: Why is only the Online/Standard supplier stock marked low?
faq.a: The supplied seller data specifically marks Standard / 标准版 as 即将售罄. Therefore the overall item remains available, Offline/Regular remains available, and Online/Standard is preserved as low_supplier_stock.
